 The only thing fans should be hunting for now is a ticket. HUNTR/X is gearing up to take the stage with the KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour , bringing Rumi, Mira and Zoey to life through animation rather than live performances from singers EJAE, Audrey Nuna and Rei Ami . Instead, fans can look forward to an immersive spectacle featuring ultramodern performance technology, animated characters, live-action stunts and interactive experiences. The Saja Boys and Derpy Tiger will also join the adventure.

 Advertisement Advertisement Kicking off in June 2027 , the highly anticipated tour is expected to draw huge crowds, with demand for tickets likely to be strong given the film's massive global popularity and devoted fanbase. Fans hoping to catch HUNTR/X live should act quickly when tickets go on sale , as popular dates and venues could sell out fast. The next important purchase you should make after securing a ticket is the official KPop Demon Hunters HUNTR/X and Saja Boys lightsticks .
 The tour will travel across North America, the United Kingdom and Europe, with additional stops in Asia Pacific and Latin America still to be announced. General-sale tickets go on sale Nov. 20, 2026, at 10 a.m. local venue time through Ticketmaster and resale platforms like StubHub , SeatGeek and Vivid Seats , where tickets are often discounted.
 Buy Tickets KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour Online  EDITOR'S PICK 
  StubHub 
  Get KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour tickets for less at StubHub , a popular resale marketplace where fans and professional ticket sellers list seats for concerts and other live entertainment. Since sellers choose their own prices, shoppers can browse options above or below the original ticket price. Its FanProtect Guarantee offers added purchase reassurance by helping buyers secure valid tickets. It's a useful option for comparing available seats and tracking prices as show dates approach. 
 Buy Tickets KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour Online  BEST PRICE 
  SeatGeek 
 SeatGeek gives shoppers another place to compare KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour tickets through a resale marketplace that lets buyers browse and compare available listings. Its Deal Score feature helps buyers evaluate listings by weighing factors such as ticket price and seat location, making it easier to spot budget-friendly options. Eligible purchases are also covered by its Buyer Guarantee, which promises valid entry and ticket delivery before the event. 
 Buy Tickets KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour Online  DISCOUNTS FOR APPLICABLE CUSTOMERS 
  Vivid Seats 
 Vivid Seats is another option for buying KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour tickets. The platform connects concertgoers with independent ticket sellers and offers a 100% Buyer Guarantee covering ticket authenticity, delivery and valid entry. Shoppers who qualify can also receive a 10% discount, including military personnel, first responders, medical providers, nurses, teachers and students. Verification through ID.me is required on its website. It's another marketplace worth comparing when searching for available seats.
